strategies.label: Hash tenant_id
strategies.detail: Keeps one tenant local, but a dominant tenant remains an indivisible hot key.
strategies.consequence: Tenant reads remain local; watch the largest tenant because adding idle shards cannot split that key.

strategies.label: Hash order_id
strategies.detail: Balances point writes while scattering each tenant's history across every owner.
strategies.consequence: Write placement is even, but tenant-scoped reads pay four-way fanout and merge cost.

strategies.label: Range by created_at
strategies.detail: Keeps bounded time scans direct while concentrating current writes in the newest range.
strategies.consequence: Recent writes overwhelm the newest owner; pre-splitting time ranges only postpones the moving hotspot.

strategies.label: Directory by tenant
strategies.detail: Maps tenants explicitly so hot tenants can move, at the cost of a versioned routing dependency.
strategies.consequence: Placement can rebalance independently, but stale directory epochs must be fenced at every owner.
